name: AD_G001
semantics: mode_active_ gates moving setpoint admission.

name: AD_G002
semantics: Terminal ownership flags require a stationary stream.

name: AD_G003
semantics: The airborne gate requires armed state and positive measured height.

name: AD_G004
semantics: The propagated odometry source timestamp must be fresh.

name: AD_G005
semantics: The odometry receive timestamp must be fresh.

name: AD_G006
semantics: Typed health presence controls bounded acquisition.

name: AD_G007
semantics: Health and odometry epochs must match.

name: AD_G008
semantics: The typed health source timestamp must be fresh.

name: AD_G009
semantics: The typed health receive timestamp must be fresh.

name: AD_G010
semantics: Health acquisition is capped by the configured wait window.

name: AD_G011
semantics: Typed health validity is required after the wait window.

name: AD_G012
semantics: A cached command must satisfy its receive lease.

name: AD_G013
semantics: A command source timestamp must be positive and not future-dated.

name: AD_G014
semantics: A command source timestamp must satisfy the age lease.

name: AD_G015
semantics: A command validity window must remain open outside recovery.

name: AD_G016
semantics: A terminal endpoint must remain within the command anchor limit.

name: AD_G017
semantics: Main tracking admission includes the phase speed window.

name: AD_G018
semantics: A rejected planner command is fail-closed.

name: AD_G019
semantics: A completed velocity-only command requests native PX4 Hold.

name: AD_G020
semantics: Unanchored terminal recovery is identity-bound.

name: AD_G021
semantics: Velocity-only output requires an allowed command role.

name: AD_G022
semantics: Velocity-only output requires READY command status.

name: AD_G023
semantics: Velocity-only timestamps must be positive and ordered.

name: AD_G024
semantics: Velocity-only odometry quaternion must be finite and valid.

name: AD_G025
semantics: PX4 local-position sample time must not be future-dated.

name: AD_G026
semantics: PX4 reset counters must match the continuity reference.

name: AD_G027
semantics: The tracking adapter mode must be enabled and supported.

name: AD_G028
semantics: The tracking adapter reference identity and PVAJ must be valid.

name: AD_G029
semantics: The LIO state and identity must be valid.

name: AD_G030
semantics: The PX4 state and heading must be valid.

name: AD_G031
semantics: The timing witness must satisfy its conservative bound.

name: AD_G032
semantics: LIO and PX4 reset counters must satisfy policy.

name: AD_G033
semantics: The sample timestamp must satisfy reference ordering.

name: AD_G034
semantics: The adapted output transform must be finite.

name: AD_G035
semantics: Velocity norm must satisfy the configured maximum.

name: AD_G036
semantics: Continuity owner identity must be same or allowed.

name: AD_G037
semantics: Previous state and configured limits must be finite.

name: AD_G038
semantics: Continuity dt must be positive and bounded.

name: AD_G039
semantics: Velocity projection residuals must satisfy viability limits.

name: AD_G040
semantics: Velocity projection numerical residual must satisfy tolerance.

name: AD_G041
semantics: Velocity and yaw output must be float-representable.

name: AD_G042
semantics: Legacy PVA ENU to NED conversion must succeed.

name: AD_G043
semantics: Legacy PVA and yaw output must be float-representable.

name: AD_G044
semantics: The no-command acquisition window must remain open.

name: AD_G045
semantics: Frame alignment speed must remain within its limit.

name: AD_G046
semantics: Frame alignment translation must remain within its limit.

name: AD_G047
semantics: PX4 local-position receive lease must be fresh.

name: AD_G048
semantics: ROS nanoseconds are converted with the fixed seconds scale.

name: AD_MESSAGE_INVALID
semantics: Presence contract or temporal admission rejected the message.

name: AD_TERMINAL_CLOSED
semantics: Failure completion or handover already closed command authority.

name: AD_RETAIN_REJECTION
semantics: A rejected replacement retains the certified command.

name: AD_STALE_ODOMETRY
semantics: Stale odometry rejects the command and fails navigation.

name: AD_ANCHOR_INVALID
semantics: Tracking envelope failure requests a safety stop.

name: AD_COMMAND_ACCEPTED
semantics: All command admission checks accepted the command.

name: AD_PROGRESS_MALFORMED
semantics: A mission progress receipt failed structural validation.

name: AD_PROGRESS_IDENTITY_INVALID
semantics: A completion receipt failed activation or command identity checks.

name: AD_PROGRESS_UNACCEPTED
semantics: The guarded completion receipt was not accepted by the locked state.

name: AD_TERMINAL_STATIONARY
semantics: A terminal stationary setpoint was emitted before moving output.

name: AD_POSITION_UNREPRESENTABLE
semantics: A terminal position could not be represented by PX4.

name: AD_AIRBORNE_GATE_CLOSED
semantics: The mode is not armed or measured height is below the airborne gate.

name: AD_HEALTH_WAIT
semantics: Typed health is absent inside the bounded acquisition window.

name: AD_HEALTH_INVALID
semantics: Typed health is invalid or stale after the wait window.

name: AD_RECEIVE_STALE
semantics: A cached command exceeded the receive lease.

name: AD_HEADER_INVALID
semantics: A command header stamp is invalid or stale.

name: AD_VALIDITY_EXPIRED
semantics: The command validity window expired outside recovery.

name: AD_PLANNER_REJECTED
semantics: A rejected planner status fails closed.

name: AD_COMPLETED_VELOCITY_HOLD
semantics: Completed velocity-only output requests native PX4 Hold.

name: AD_COMPLETED_POSITION
semantics: Completed legacy output emits a position hold when representable.

name: AD_RECOVERY_DEADLINE_INVALID
semantics: An unrepresentable recovery deadline fails closed.

name: AD_VELOCITY_ONLY_PATH
semantics: Velocity-only tracking publishes or requests hold on rejection.

name: AD_PVA_UNREPRESENTABLE
semantics: Legacy PVA output fails closed when conversion is invalid.

name: AD_ACQUISITION_OPEN
semantics: The airborne command acquisition window is still open.

name: BR_DIAGNOSTIC_STAMP_VALID
semantics: The diagnostic source timestamp is positive and increasing.

name: BR_PUBLIC_GENERATION_CHANGED
semantics: A newer public generation is observed by the latch.

name: BR_DIAGNOSTIC_TRACKING
semantics: Typed diagnostics report a valid tracking state.

name: BR_SOURCE_IDENTITY_NEW
semantics: The incoming epoch and sequence are strictly newer.

name: BR_EPOCH_CHANGED
semantics: An accepted sample starts a different localization epoch.

name: BR_CONVERSION_VALID
semantics: ROS odometry conversion produced a frame.

name: BR_FLOAT_VALID
semantics: The converted frame is float-representable.

name: BR_COVARIANCE_VALID
semantics: All covariance components are float-representable.

name: BR_CONFIG_VALID
semantics: Continuity configuration is finite and non-overflowing.

name: BR_FRAME_VALID
semantics: The current or previous frame is finite and normalized.

name: BR_SOURCE_VALID
semantics: The upstream source validity flag is true.

name: BR_GENERATION_VALID
semantics: A positive public generation is valid.

name: BR_CURRENT_FRAME_VALID
semantics: The converted frame carries a valid frame flag.

name: BR_BASELINE_AVAILABLE
semantics: A trusted same-generation baseline exists.

name: BR_PREVIOUS_FRAME_VALID
semantics: The stored previous frame remains valid.

name: BR_GENERATION_SAME
semantics: The stored and current public generations match.

name: BR_TIMESTAMP_INCREASING
semantics: The current timestamp is strictly after the baseline.

name: BR_DT_TOO_SMALL
semantics: Continuity dt is below the configured minimum.

name: BR_DT_TOO_LARGE
semantics: Continuity dt exceeds the configured maximum.

name: BR_THRESHOLD_FINITE
semantics: Computed jump thresholds are finite.

name: BR_JUMP_DETECTED
semantics: Observed motion exceeds the allowed continuity thresholds.

name: BR_GATE_READY
semantics: Every publication gate is true and no jump is latched.
